title: Together AI Launches Together Link to Route Open Models in Coding Harnesses
summary:
Software developers can now automate AI model selection within their environments based on the difficulty of the code fix. Together AI has released Together Link, a client side integration that allows users to run frontier open models within their chosen coding harnesses and utilizes an Auto router to assign low cost models for simple fixes or more capable models for complex tasks.

The tool enables users to monitor their spending while accessing the hosted model ecosystem provided by Together AI. By bridging the gap between hosted open models and a developer's existing toolset, the service aims to streamline the deployment of artificial intelligence within software engineering workflows.
